sidebar_empty_hint: Add a local repository to start a thread.
project_dialog_description: Add a local repository, or clone one from GitHub.
project_setup_hint: Setup script runs in every new worktree with:
thread_org_spend_limit_hint: Ask an organization admin to raise the monthly spend limit. A session reset does not clear this limit.
thread_composer_placeholder: Ask anything. Type @ to mention a file or thread, / to run a skill.
thread_composer_steer_placeholder: Steer the agent… Enter sends while it works.
thread_empty_hint: Ask {provider} to read, change or explain code in this project.
markdown_diagram_failed: Could not draw this diagram. Showing its source instead.
approval_scope_command: Allow for session also approves this exact command until the session ends:
approval_scope_path: Allow for session also approves {tool} on this path until the session ends:
approval_scope_domain: Allow for session also approves {tool} on any URL at this domain until the session ends:
approval_scope_tool: Allow for session approves every {tool} call, whatever its input, until the session ends.
secret_request_exists: A value with this name is already stored. Saving replaces it.
secret_request_hint: The value is stored on this machine and never shown to the agent.
panel_removed_hint: The worktree was removed. New runs use the project root.
panel_pr_merged_hint: The pull request is merged. Archive the thread to put it away.
panel_setup_failed: The setup script failed. See the exit code at the end of the log.
command_palette_open: Go to thread, project or file
palette_placeholder: Search threads, projects and files, type > for commands or % for text
palette_search_placeholder: Search message text and the open thread's files
search_ripgrep_missing: Install ripgrep (rg) and restart KKCode to search files
settings_models_hint: New threads start with the default model of their agent.
settings_models_unlisted: {provider} did not list its models. Enter a model id instead.
settings_models_failed: Could not list {provider} models: {message}. Enter a model id instead.
settings_model_preset_hint: The thread model picker lists only these. A thread's current model always stays listed.
settings_keybindings_hint: Select Record, then press the new shortcut. Escape cancels, Backspace removes the shortcut.
settings_keybindings_conflict: Also bound to {commands}. Only one of them will run.
settings_linear_hint: Create a personal API key in Linear under Settings > API. This enables Linear tools for agents. To start threads automatically, create a Linear issue automation in Settings > Automations.
attachment_add_hint: Attach files. You can also paste images or drop files here.
error_persistence: Could not read or write the local database. Try again, and restart KKCode if it keeps failing.
error_project_path_taken: Another project already uses this folder.
error_project_root_invalid: That path is not a folder. Pick an existing folder.
error_pull_request_url_invalid: That is not a GitHub pull request link. Use https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123.
error_linear_request: The Linear request failed. Check the API key in Settings > Integrations.
error_schema: KKCode got data in an unexpected shape. Restart the app, and report a bug if it happens again.
error_ports: Could not inspect or stop the process: {detail}
error_thread_busy: This thread is still running or waiting for approval. Stop it before you archive it.
error_fs_access: Could not read this folder. It may have been moved or deleted.
pr_links_empty: None linked yet. Create one from this branch, or ask an agent to open one.
viewer_binary: This is a binary file, so it is not shown.
viewer_truncated: Showing the first 1 MB of this file.
viewer_changed_on_disk: The file changed on disk after you started editing.
agents_empty: Sub-agents this thread spawns appear here.
agents_missing: Nothing is recorded for this sub-agent.
sidebar_drag_instructions: To reorder, press Space on the handle, move with the arrow keys, then press Space again to drop. Escape cancels.
sidebar_drag_cancel: Reorder cancelled. {title} is back where it was.
sidebar_reorder_failed: Could not save the new order: {message}
delete_dialog_body: Deletes "{title}" with its messages and linked pull requests. This cannot be undone.
delete_dialog_remove_worktree: Also remove its worktree, and its branch if merged
home_description: Run Claude Code, Codex and Muse Code on your local repositories. Each thread can get its own git worktree, prepared by your setup script.
home_hint_ready: New threads start in {project}. Pick another project from the + in the sidebar.
settings_slack_hint: Slack mention automations use this token. Slack only allows message search with an xoxp- user token, so give a Slack app the search:read user scope and paste its user OAuth token.
automations_description: Start a thread when a webhook arrives or a new issue or mention shows up. Polling triggers check every minute.
automations_empty_hint: Create one to start threads from webhooks, GitHub or Linear issues, or Slack mentions.
automations_empty_no_project: Add a project first. Every automation starts its threads in a project.
automations_delete_description: Deletes its run history and webhook secret too. Threads it started stay.
automations_bind_loopback_hint: Only programs on this machine can send webhooks.
automations_bind_all_hint: Other devices on your network or tailnet can send webhooks. Each request still needs a valid signature.
automations_dialog_description: Each event renders the prompt template and starts a new thread with it.
automations_trigger_fixed: The trigger type cannot change after creation.
automations_webhook_hint: You get the webhook URL and its signing secret after you create the automation.
automations_repo_hint: owner/name, read with the gh CLI
automations_labels_hint: Optional, comma separated. Issues need every label.
automations_linear_hint: Uses the Linear API key from Integrations. Only issues created after you enable the automation start threads.
automations_slack_hint: Messages that mention this user start threads. Uses the Slack user token from Integrations.
automations_prompt_placeholder: Triage this and propose a fix: {example}
automations_prompt_hint: Placeholders are filled from the event. Missing fields become empty.
automations_worktree_hint: Each run gets its own branch and worktree.
automations_branch_hint: Rendered like the prompt, then made branch-safe. Leave empty to name it after the automation.
automations_enabled_hint: Disabled automations ignore webhooks and stop polling.
automations_webhook_url_hint: POST JSON here, signed with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body in X-KKCODE-Signature or X-Hub-Signature-256 as sha256=<hex>.
automations_webhook_url_lan_hint: Listening on all interfaces. From another device, use an address it can reach, such as this machine's Tailscale name. Sign the raw body with HMAC-SHA256 in X-KKCODE-Signature or X-Hub-Signature-256.
automations_payload_hint: JSON the prompt template reads, as an event would deliver it. Run now skips duplicate detection.
automations_payload_invalid: The payload is not valid JSON.
automations_secret_description: Configure the sender with this URL and secret. The secret is shown only now.
automations_secret_hint: Store it in the sender now. To get a new one, create a new automation.
project_edit_description: Change the name, folder and setup script of {project}.

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} thread, with its messages and linked pull requests, is deleted. The folder on disk stays. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count} threads, with their messages and linked pull requests, are deleted. The folder on disk stays. This cannot be undone.

project_delete_remove_worktrees: Also remove its worktrees, and their branches if merged
settings_mono_font_hint: Used for code, diffs and command output.
pr_card_failed: Couldn't load this pull request. It may be an issue, private, or gh may be signed out.
pr_gh_missing: Install the GitHub CLI (gh) to see pull request status and create pull requests.
pr_gh_signed_out_after: in a terminal to see pull request status and create pull requests.
settings_github_missing: The GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed.
settings_github_signed_out_before: gh is installed but not signed in. Run
settings_github_hint: KKCode uses your gh login to show pull request status, create pull requests, and poll GitHub issues for automations. Get gh at cli.github.com.
sidebar_pull_request_stack: Open pull request #{number}, the newest of {count} linked
settings_text_generation_model_hint: Names a thread and its branch from its first message.
settings_default_access_hint: New threads start with this. Change it for one thread from the composer.
thread_fast_mode_hint: Faster responses that use more of your plan
composer_commands_failed: Could not load commands and skills: {message}
access_supervised_hint_codex: Asks before any command that isn't read-only
access_auto_hint_claude: Claude approves safe actions and asks about the rest
access_auto_hint_claude_edits: Edits run without asking; commands still ask
access_auto_hint_codex: Runs freely in the sandbox; asks to go beyond it
access_auto_hint_muse: Runs freely in the sandbox, network included; asks to go beyond it
git_graph_hint: Select a commit to see its changes.
diff_base_turn: Changes since the latest turn started
diff_no_worktree: This thread runs in the project root, so it has no worktree diff. Switch to Latest turn.
diff_no_turn: No turn has started in a git checkout yet.
pr_detail_failed: Could not load the pull request: {message}
pr_merge_blocked_draft: Drafts can't be merged. Mark it ready for review on GitHub first.
pr_close_body: The pull request closes on GitHub without merging. You can reopen it there.
settings_notifications_hint: KKCode notifies you about threads you are not looking at.
settings_notifications_needs_input_hint: The agent is waiting for an approval, an answer or a secret.
settings_notifications_failed_hint: A turn failed, was stopped, or hit a usage limit.
settings_notifications_sound_hint: Play a short chime with each notification. Each kind has its own.
settings_account_signed_out_claude: Not signed in. Run claude in a terminal, then /login.
settings_account_signed_out_codex: Not signed in. Run codex login in a terminal.
settings_account_signed_out_muse: Not signed in. Run muse login in a terminal.
settings_default_account_hint: A thread keeps its account once it has started.
account_dialog_add_description: Point kkcode at a CLI and a config directory. Sign in from a terminal afterwards.
account_dialog_binary_description: The {provider} CLI this account runs. A bare name is looked up on PATH.
account_dialog_config_dir_description: Sets {variable}. Holds the account's login, settings and transcripts.
account_remove_body: Removes the account from kkcode. Its config directory stays on disk. Delete the threads that use it first.
error_account_in_use: Threads still use this account. Delete them first.
settings_notifications_denied_hint: Enable notifications by granting permission in macOS System Settings.
settings_notifications_not_determined_hi: Enable notifications by granting permission in macOS System Settings.
remote_description: Steer threads from the kkcode phone app. The phone connects straight to this machine, so it needs to be on the same network or tailnet.
remote_enable_hint: Paired phones can read threads, answer approvals, send prompts and open terminals in worktrees.
remote_bind_loopback_hint: Only programs on this machine can connect. Choose all interfaces to reach it from a phone.
remote_bind_all_hint: Devices on your network or tailnet can connect. Each one still needs the access token.
remote_network_note: Over Tailscale the connection is encrypted by WireGuard. On a plain LAN it is unencrypted, so keep remote control off on networks you do not trust.
remote_pair_failed: Could not load the pairing code: {message}
remote_pair_host_hint: The address the phone uses to reach this machine. Pick the Tailscale name when you are away from home.
remote_pair_token_hint: The QR code and URL contain the access token. Anyone who scans it can control kkcode.
remote_rotate_hint: Issues a new token and disconnects every paired phone.
browser_pick_hint: Click an element to add it to your message. Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Esc cancels.
browser_start_hint: Type a URL above, or open a port this thread listens on.
thread_worktree_ref_placeholder: main, #123, or a pull request URL
archive_dialog_worktree: Archiving deletes the worktree folder {path}, including uncommitted changes.
archive_dialog_branch: Deletes branch {branch} only if it is merged into {baseRef}.
settings_archive_hint: Archived threads leave the sidebar's Threads tab and stay readable under Archived.
settings_archive_when_merged: Archive when all linked pull requests merge
settings_archive_when_merged_hint: Archives the thread once all linked pull requests are merged.
settings_archive_remove_worktree_hint: Deletes the worktree folder, including uncommitted changes
settings_experimental_hint: Features that are still changing. They may change shape or go away.
settings_tiny_vm_hint: Gives each thread a disposable Linux desktop on your sbx host. Agents operate it with the vm tools, and you watch or take control in the side panel.
settings_tiny_vm_not_configured: No sbx login found. Run `sbx login <url>`, or set `SBX_URL` and `SBX_TOKEN`.
vm_empty_body: The agent starts a disposable Linux desktop when it needs one.
vm_agent_waiting: The agent is waiting for you to hand back control
vm_stop_confirm: Click again to stop the VM
vm_floating_body: The screen is floating over the conversation.
